sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 520)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serialized classic drama metadata, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across hard-hitting police docudramas, BBC maritime literary serials, hardboiled detective mysteries, and pulp noir, three explosive cases of Phillips H. Lord's *Gangbusters* (1937, 1944, 1951), Patrick Malahide in Joseph Conrad's *Lord Jim* (1985), Dick Powell as Richard Rogue in *Rogue's Gallery* (1946), and Larry Haines as Mickey Spillane's *Mike Hammer* (1937–1985):
